item.title: Building a Local Smart Home Hub: Unifying HRV and Air Quality
item.description:
We’ve just wrapped up a journey building a fully integrated smart home control system that bridges a NovingAIR PHANTOM Wireless 160 Heat Recovery Ventilation (HRV) unit and an 8-in-1 air quality monitor..

The idea is simple: locally monitor indoor air quality in real-time and automatically control ventilation speeds to maintain a healthy environment, all managed through a custom mobile dashboard.
